intro: Nine articles published between 2026-05-18 and 2026-10-24 carry the patch-guidance tag, covering remediation advice for critical vulnerabilities across government, technology, AI/ML, critical infrastructure, and enterprise sectors. The most severe entries include CVE-2025-39682, CVE-2026-60004, and CVE-2026-7301, each rated CVSS 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-8954 and CVE-2026-8959 at CVSS 9.6. Coverage spans the United States, Europe, Global, and North America, with a severity mix of four critical, one high, and one medium. The collection offers guidance for organisations working through patching decisions tied to these specific flaws.
